title: Inventory Timer
description: Want to improve your toteming? Look no further, you can track how long you are in your inventory. Also useful for Netherite and Diamond Potion you can track how long you are in your inventory and upgrade your potting speed.
body:
InventoryTimer is built for one purpose: turning hesitation into instinct.
It creates a focused environment where every milisecond matters, helping you sharpen totem timing and potion speed under pressure. 

Most players don’t lose because of aim—they lose because they’re late.
Late to swap. Late to pot. Late to react.

- Train totem pops until they’re automatic
- Improve inventory speed without thinking
- Build real muscle memory that carries into PvP
